The “E” variations remove some of the I/O found on the standard encoder and decoder and retain only the core functionalities that suite most applications. Integrated support for network-based control allows IR and RS-232 signals to be transmitted alongside video and audio, ensuring compatibility with third-party control platforms and automation systems.
Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.

The compact, installer-friendly enclosure is ideal for rack mounting or discreet AV cabinet placement. Clear LED status indicators provide at-a-glance confirmation of power, network activity, and signal presence, while efficient thermal design ensures stable operation in demanding professional environments.

network: The NetworkHD 610-TX expand the functionality of the powerful SDVoE 600 series product line. The 610-TX retain many of the capabilities found on the other models, such as full HDMI 2.0 encoding, zero latency transmissions, video wall and multiview processing. However, the 610 packs an extra punch by incorporating a Dante/AES67 output, allowing audio from the HDMI or analog audio input to transmit to Dante/AES67 enabled amplifiers, DSP or mixers. The TX is also equipped with a full speed USB 1.1 HID chipset, maximizing compatibility with thousands of USB peripherals for extension over the network, such as a keyboard/mouse & touchscreens, or just simple data transfers.

The NHD-610-TX is equipped with a 2CH Dante audio transmitter. Audio from either the HDMI or analog audio input can be sent over the network using Dante protocols for a latency free and lossless delivery to compatible audio equipment. We’ve also made sure AES67 is supported to expand compatibility with even more audio receivers.

All 600 series components support encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range formats such as Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG. Most HDMI content is transmitted completely uncompressed and delivered over the network latency free using genlock synchronization.
Compatible with the 802.3at PoE+ protocol, the 610s can power from a compatible network switch removing the need to use cumbersome DC power supplies.
An auxiliary 1GbE LAN port provides a bridged connection to the main 10G port for connecting peripherals. It can also be setup to isolate Dante audio to a separate network.
